title: World Models as Adversaries: Multi-Agent Self-Play Fine-Tuning for Robust Motion Planning
abstract: arXiv:2607.10630v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robust motion planning in dense traffic requires autonomous vehicles to interact in rare and safety-critical scenarios that are underrepresented in naturalistic driving data. Although adversarial training offers a feasible solution, existing methods often rely on external scenario generators, heuristic perturbations, or simulator-heavy rollouts, which makes them difficult to integrate with modern autoregressive planners. Here, we cast adversarially robust planner learning as a constrained min-max game and propose Adversarial World Modeling (AWM), a theoretically grounded multi-agent self-play fine-tuning framework. Since solving the exact game is intractable, AWM introduces a principled decoupled solver. In the inner minimization, the planner's predictive world model is converted into a role-conditioned adversary that learns sparse, scene-adaptive attack coalitions via counterfactual credit assignment. translated_title: 世界模型作为对手：面向鲁棒运动规划的多智能体自博弈微调
translated_abstract: 在密集交通中实现鲁棒运动规划，要求自动驾驶车辆能够在自然驾驶数据中代表性不足的罕见且安全关键场景中进行交互。尽管对抗性训练提供了一种可行的解决方案，但现有方法通常依赖外部场景生成器、启发式扰动或繁重的仿真器推演，这使其难以与现代自回归规划器相集成。在此，我们将对抗鲁棒的规划器学习构建为一个受约束的极小极大博弈，并提出对抗世界建模，这是一个具有理论基础的多智能体自博弈微调框架。由于精确求解该博弈是不可行的，AWM 引入了一种有原则的解耦求解器。在内层最小化中，规划器的预测世界模型被转化为一个角色条件化的对手，通过反事实信用分配学习稀疏的、场景自适应的攻击联盟。在外层最大化中……（原文摘要至此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出对抗世界建模（AWM）框架，将规划器自身的世界模型转化为角色条件化的对抗性对手，通过多智能体自博弈微调生成稀疏且场景自适应的攻击，从而在罕见安全关键场景下训练出鲁棒的自动驾驶运动规划器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Adversarial World Modeling (AWM), a theoretically grounded multi-agent self-play fine-tuning framework that converts the planner's own predictive world model into a role-conditioned adversary generating sparse, scene-adaptive attacks, enabling robust autonomous driving motion planning in rare, safety-critical scenarios.
